title: Offline build: bios corpus, gender metrics, guards and labeler
description:
## Purpose

Make the unified harness run the bios corpus offline, with gender-sensitivity metrics and guards, at $0.

## Scope

Corpus parametrization, dedupe/leakage assertions, twin metrics, gender-cue guards, bios labeler with offline fake, free baselines, offline dry run and $0 replay. The planted-bias corpus stays the default and its replays keep passing.

## Definition of done

Offline dry run passes end to end on bios with fake engines; $0 baseline replay reproduces the free rows; `make test` green.

## Cost cap

$0 (no live calls).

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
